audit.whatIsWrong: Spirit Cleave (W) is never treated as a shield anywhere in the writable text — it is only mentioned as a late-game turret-shredding cone. Soul Unbound's cooldown is never given, and Fate Sealed is never named.
audit.why: Spirit Cleave grants Yone a shield on a 14s base cooldown that scales down with attack speed, so it absorbs exactly the burst window a stunned nest is trying to land — the missing-interactions entry flags this as applicable and absent. Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s, so at rank 1 a spent E leaves 22 seconds where he has no snap-back out of the nest. Mortal Steel's 2-stack cast is the dash-plus-knockup, and Fate Sealed (120/100/80s) is the blink that comes through the turrets.
audit.corrected: Name the Spirit Cleave shield and force it out before committing; give Soul Unbound's 22s rank-1 cooldown; name Mortal Steel and Fate Sealed.
